items.title: Hubbell (HUBB) Stock Looks Overvalued On Cash Flow But Fair On Earnings
items.summary: Hubbell stock has delivered a strong 5 year run, yet the current share price now sits above the latest Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate while earnings based multiples look closer to fair. Hubbell has returned about 149.4% over 5 years, which puts more pressure on today’s buyers to judge whether that past gain already reflects much of the long term opportunity.
